summary: Compact, non-interactive inline label for a status, category or count.

usage.text: Short text goes in the default slot. The icon attribute is a registry name (see violet-icon; register it first) rendered before the text and always decorative.
color is visual only, so the text must state the status itself. A badge has no events; do not put buttons or links in it.

a11y.text: The label attribute gives the host role img named by it, replacing the slotted text for assistive technology. Use it when the text alone, such as a bare count, is not meaningful.
decorative sets aria-hidden on the host and drops any role and label; use it only when nearby text already says the same thing.
